brief: Name the retired engineer who is the white rabbit: an English woman born in 1953 in Swindon, one of the few women apprentices in the railway works in the early 1970s; after the works closed in 1986 she retrained as a programmer and wrote code for the interbank clearing system; now in her late sixties, a bitcoin purist moving her savings out of the old machine. Propose a first name and surname plausible for 1953 and what she insists on being called.
context: Language: British English. Setting: Swindon and the Wiltshire downs, 2019-2023. Tone: wry, humane, curious. Existing names: Kieran Hale (protagonist, called Kez), Faye Titcombe (author persona, not a character).
constraints: Plausible for an English girl born in Swindon in 1953
Distinct in sound and initials from Kieran Hale and Faye Titcombe
Ordinary, not symbolic; no names from The Matrix, Harry Potter or Alice in Wonderland
